item.subject: maths
item.stem:
In the diagram, lines $p$ and $q$ are parallel and transversal $t$ crosses them. Angle $a$ measures $65^\circ$. Angle $b$ is alternate to angle $a$.

Which claim about angle $b$ is correct?

options.A: Angle $b$ equals $65^\circ$ only when $t$ is perpendicular to $p$ and $q$.
options.B: Equal alternate angles $a$ and $b$ are what create the parallel marks on $p$ and $q$.
options.C: Angle $b$ equals $65^\circ$ because alternate angles formed by a transversal of parallel lines are equal.
